name: Lucan

attributes.attribute: Arthurian hero and trusted knight of the Round Table
served King Arthur as butler for his whole reign
died trying to save Arthur at the battle of Camlan

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Lucan was a hero of Arthurian legend, a trusted knight of King Arthur's court. He served Arthur as his butler for the whole of the king's reign. Lucan stood beside Arthur at the battle of Camlan, where Arthur was wounded. Though the cut that struck Lucan was fatal, he still tried to save his king. He gave his own life in that attempt.

okr.objective: Document the Arthurian hero Lucan and his loyalty to King Arthur.
